name: taskjian
description: 任笺 TaskJian — 轻办公任务便签

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @taskjian/renderer dev" "pnpm --filter @taskjian/shared build && pnpm --filter @taskjian/main build && pnpm --filter @taskjian/preload build && wait-on tcp:5173 && electron packages/main/dist/index.js"
scripts.dev:main: pnpm --filter @taskjian/shared build && pnpm --filter @taskjian/main build && pnpm --filter @taskjian/preload build && electron packages/main/dist/index.js
